runpod_gpu_type_id.label: GPU type
runpod_gpu_type_id.help: RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB runs the open-weights H3 at 736p; RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GB, about twice as fast, runs native 1088p comfortably), L40S and A100 are the alternatives. Switching GPU still needs the owner's go-ahead.

runpod_cloud_type.label: Cloud
runpod_cloud_type.help: Secure Cloud runs in RunPod's own data centres; Community Cloud is cheaper but hosts are third parties, and the episode's frames sit on them.

runpod_data_center_id.label: Data centre
runpod_data_center_id.help: Optional. Where to try first when the site opens a volume; an existing volume decides for itself.

runpod_network_volume_id.label: Network volume ID
runpod_network_volume_id.help: Optional. Left empty, the site uses a volume in the account big enough for the models, or opens one.

runpod_image.label: Container image
runpod_image.help: Published by ops/runpod and pinned by @sha256 digest; moving tags such as :latest are refused.

runpod_serverless_endpoint_id.label: Serverless endpoint ID
runpod_serverless_endpoint_id.help: Phase two, for the worker to buy clips itself; leave empty for now.

runpod_idle_stop_minutes.label: Stop an idle pod after (minutes)
runpod_idle_stop_minutes.help: A pod with no heartbeat from its video tool for this long is stopped by the site. 1–120.

runpod_max_pod_hours.label: Longest pod run (hours)
runpod_max_pod_hours.help: A pod is stopped after this long whatever it is doing. 1–24.

runpod_monthly_usd_cap.label: Monthly spending cap (USD)
runpod_monthly_usd_cap.help: Counted per UTC month, running pods included; no new pod starts past it. 0 allows none.

runpod_default_canvas.label: Default 1080p method
runpod_default_canvas.help: Generate at H3's training size and upscale, or generate natively at 1920×1088 (unmeasured, slower).

runpod_default_profile.label: Default sampling profile
runpod_default_profile.help: smooth for most shots, hero for faces and identity shots, draft for composition only.

gpu_route_default.label: Default GPU route
gpu_route_default.help: What a video tool allowed to use both Colab and RunPod is told to use. Auto picks RunPod for 1080p canvases or when Colab is short of compute units.

runpod_api_key.label: RunPod API key
runpod_api_key.help: Starts and stops the H3 GPU pods. Encrypted on the server and only ever sent to rest.runpod.io and api.runpod.io; video tools never receive it. Create it at console.runpod.io → Settings → API Keys.

tokens.runpodAccessHelp: Besides narration, this token may then ask the site to start and stop RunPod GPU pods for H3 clips. The RunPod key stays on the server; the monthly cap and auto-stop on the RunPod card apply.
tokens.pairRunpod: This computer also asks to start RunPod GPU pods through the site: once allowed, its token can start and stop pods within the RunPod card's caps (the key never leaves the server).

panel.title: RunPod pods
panel.intro: Pods the site started for video tools. Each one is stopped when its batch ends, when it goes quiet past the idle limit, after the longest run, or when the month reaches the cap.
panel.loadFailed: Could not load the RunPod pods.
panel.notConfigured: The RunPod card is not filled in yet; no pod can start until it is.
panel.noVolume: No volume yet. The first pod opens one where the GPU has stock, or open one here.
panel.startNote: Billing starts now. It uses the existing volume or opens one, and is stopped when this page closes and the idle time passes.
panel.createNote: {gb} GB where the GPU has stock now, {usd} a month until you delete it.
